LESSON: FAREWELL PILGRIMAGE (HIJJATUL WID’A) • FAREWELL SERMON

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon
2. Practise Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon in the examples.
2. Explain Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon
2. Practise Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Farewell Pilgrimage (Hijjatul Wid’a) • farewell Sermon

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
